graph.title: LED Bar Graph
notes: The circuit image shows 10 discrete red LEDs; per the matched parts list they are modelled as one led-bar-graph (A1..A10 / C1..C10), with segment k in the k-th LED position.

Breadboard row letters follow the image: the upper half is rows f-j (catalogue bank 'b') and the lower half is rows a-e (bank 't'). The top rail row nearest the black line is treated as the negative rail (tn).

Bar graph cathodes are placed in the top ground rail (tn.5, 7, ... 23); anodes in the upper half at columns 4, 6, ... 22, each through a 220 ohm resistor bridging the centre gap to a lower-half column where a jumper wire runs to Arduino pins 11 down to 2.

Pot: GND leg at column 27 and VCC at column 29 (lower half), wiper at column 28 (upper half). GND comes from the ground rail via a black wire, 5V from the Arduino via a red wire, wiper to A0 via a yellow wire. Exact hole rows are estimated from the picture.
Arduino GND next to pin 13 is mapped to GND.1.

breadboard.name: Solderless breadboard
breadboard.port_rule: Holes are named '<column><bank>.<row>': column 1-30, bank 't' (top half, rows a-e) or 'b' (bottom half, rows f-j), e.g. '12t.c', '7b.h'. The 5 holes of one column-bank are one strip. Power rails: 'tp.<n>', 'tn.<n>', 'bp.<n>', 'bn.<n>' (each rail is one strip).
